import json
def f(T):
    H=len(T);W=len(T[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if T[r][c]==2]
    P=set(pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in T]
    # aligned pair (share row or col) -> spine; others attach perpendicular toward it
    pair=None
    for i,a in enumerate(pts):
        for b in pts[i+1:]:
            if a[0]==b[0] or a[1]==b[1]: pair=(a,b); break
    if pair is not None:
        a,b=pair
        if a[0]==b[0]:  # horizontal spine
            lr=a[0]; lo=min(a[1],b[1]); hi=max(a[1],b[1])
            for c in range(lo,hi+1): out[lr][c]=3
            for p in [x for x in pts if x not in {a,b}]:
                r,c=p
                for rr in range(min(lr,r)+1,max(lr,r)): out[rr][c]=3
        else:  # vertical spine
            lc=a[1]; lo=min(a[0],b[0]); hi=max(a[0],b[0])
            for r in range(lo,hi+1): out[r][lc]=3
            for p in [x for x in pts if x not in {a,b}]:
                r,c=p
                for cc in range(min(c,lc)+1,max(c,lc)): out[r][cc]=3
    else:
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        mr=rs[len(rs)//2]; mc=cs[len(cs)//2]
        for p in pts:
            r,c=p
            if r==mr:
                for cc in range(min(c,mc)+1,max(c,mc)): out[r][cc]=3
            else:
                for rr in range(min(r,mr)+1,max(r,mr)): out[rr][c]=3
    return out

    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
